product_conclusions: G2 attributed proposition ledger with coverage and relations is the product core
candidate visibility may precede promotion only with status and evidence visibility
progressive card is the default surface; 20-section dossier is on-demand
routing is deterministic; model hints are non-authoritative
generic envelope requires explicit domain extensions rather than a mega-schema
batch extraction creates durable queryable knowledge; on-demand answers must remain bounded and non-promoting
